title: Measure greatness by what the heart clings to
summary: True greatness is loving attachment to the Lord, not to Maya's scale. Measure greatness by freedom from anxious status.
takeaway: Measure greatness by freedom from anxious status.
lifeApplication: When status enters the room, notice whether the heart is clinging to the Lord or to Maya's anxious scale.
